1769616027081.markdown: --- --- # Dmitry Krylov [t.me/dm1trykrylov](https://t.me/dm1trykrylov) : [github.com/dm1trykrylov](https://github.com/dm1trykrylov) : [(+7) 922-513-1245](https://wa.me/79225131245) [linkedin.com/in/dm1trykrylov](https://linkedin.com/in/dm1trykrylov/) : [krylov.de@phystech.edu](mailto:krylov.de@phystech.edu) ## About me I graduated from MIPT with bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science. My academic and practical interests focus on applying mathematical modelling, statistical methods, and data analysis to economic problems, particularly in forecasting and empirical analysis. I am interested in building and evaluating quantitative models, working with real-world data, and using computational tools to test economic hypotheses and study causal relationships. I am open to different areas of economics and motivated to work in research-oriented analytical environments. ## Experience **Data Analyst Intern** : **Bank of Russia** : **Sep 2025 - Dec 2025** - Contributed to the preparation of analytical materials for the Board of Directors' decisions on the policy rate. - In the Modelling and Forecasting Department, developed a Python program for seasonal adjustment and forecasting of the Consumer Price Index (CPI). - Automated data retrieval from databases, forecasting workflows, and version control, improving efficiency and reproducibility. **Research Intern** : **Institute of Information Transmission Problems (IITP RAS)** : **Feb 2024 - Jul 2024** - Joined collaborative project aimed at improving colour space transform on digital images. - Implemented novel colour space transform algorithm based on physically plausible illumination distribution. - Designed an evaluation pipeline and measured performance relative to baseline method. - Presented results at the annual university conference at MIPT. ## Education **BSc in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science** : **2022 - 2026** Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology (MIPT), GPA 4.8 / 5 : Moscow, Russia **MA in Economics** : **2026 - 2028** New Economic School : Moscow, Russia ## Skills **Programming Languages:** Python, C/C++, SQL, Go **Tools and Frameworks:** Git, Linux, Docker, Scientific Python (NumPy, scikit-learn), $\LaTeX$ **Languages:** English (proficient), Russian (native) ## Projects **Optimal Stopping for a Conditioned Random Walk** : **2025 - 2026** This is my bachelor's thesis. It studies the optimal stopping problem for a 1-dimensional random walk conditioned to remain between the boundaries linearly dependent on the step number. The problem is motivated by asset price dynamics within a price corridor. I devised analytical formulation and solution of the optimal stopping problem, defined the value function to characterize the state of the random walk and proved some theorems regarding the asymptotic properties of the value function. I presented the results on the 68th Russian National Scientific MIPT Conference ## Awards and Honors **Winner** (top 0.5% among 200,000+ participants), "I - Professional" National Student Competition in Mathematical Modeling : 2024 **Diploma Winner** (3rd Degree, top 5% among 1,000+ participants), HSE National Competition "Higher League" in Economics : 2025 **Presidential Scholarship** awarded for high academic performance and achievements in student competitions : 2022-2026 **Merit-Based Scholarship** at MIPT, awarded for academic excellence : 2025

Профиль моей программы: Математическая физика, компьютерные технологии и математическое моделирование в экономике.
